comments.text:
This is why I am so infinitely appreciative of how Oregon does primaries and elections.  Not only is all voting by mail-in ballot, but Oregon also produces an extensive voting informational booklet, which includes platform statements submitted by candidates, information about endorsements, and clear identification of candidate party alignment.

For ballot initiatives, any individual or organization can submit pro and con statements, which are also printed in the voter booklet, which is both incredibly helpful and sometimes surprisingly amusing.

Between the voting booklet and the mail-in format giving me the time and opportunity to do my own research, particularly for down-ballot candidates, I have never felt more able to make informed voting decisions.

Every American should have this same opportunity.
